targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name AS "Station", CASE WHEN ss.status IS NULL OR ss.status = 'idle' THEN 'frei' ELSE 'besetzt' END AS "Status", COALESCE(t.name, '-') AS "Gruppe" FROM station s LEFT JOIN station_state ss ON ss.station_id = s.station_id LEFT JOIN team t ON t.id = ss.team_id ORDER BY s.station_id

panels.title: Fortschritt der Gruppen
panels.description: Grün = abgeschlossen (Dauer), Gelb = läuft (bisherige Dauer), Rot = noch offen

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.name AS station, t.name AS team, CASE WHEN r.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN '✔ ' || to_char(r.completed_at - r.started_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') WHEN r.started_at IS NOT NULL THEN '▶ ' || to_char(now() - r.started_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') ELSE '✗' END AS zelle FROM station s CROSS JOIN team t LEFT JOIN results r ON r.team_id = t.id AND r.station_id = s.station_id ORDER BY s.station_id, t.id

panels.title: Highscore
panels.description: Ranking nach Gesamtzeit über alle Stationen. Gruppen, die noch nicht fertig sind, stehen ohne Platz darunter.

targets.rawSql: WITH tot AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM station), agg AS (SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(r.completed_at) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(r.completed_at - r.started_at), interval '0') AS total FROM team t LEFT JOIN results r ON r.team_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id, t.name) SELECT CASE WHEN done = (SELECT c FROM tot) THEN RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY (done = (SELECT c FROM tot)) ORDER BY total) END AS "Platz", name AS "Gruppe", done || ' / ' || (SELECT c FROM tot) AS "Stationen", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM total) AS "Gesamtzeit" FROM agg ORDER BY (done = (SELECT c FROM tot)) DESC, CASE WHEN done = (SELECT c FROM tot) THEN total END, done DESC, name
